rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ 'A meter bridge can measure any resistance accurately.' ✅ It is accurate only for *moderate* resistances (≈1 Ω to 1 kΩ); very high or very low resistances give poor null points.  ·  ❌ 'The null point is always at the center (50 cm) of the meter bridge.' ✅ The null point shifts depending on the ratio of resistances; it is at 50 cm *only* when the two known resistances are equal.
